stories.name: AI Chip Stock Volatility
stories.blurb: A volatile stretch for semiconductor and AI memory stocks (like AMD, Micron, SK Hynix, and Broadcom) as investors swing between selling off and buying the dip amid renewed anxiety over the AI trade.

stories.name: Broadcom Q3 Earnings Watch
stories.blurb: Coverage of Broadcom's Q3 earnings results and subsequent analyst debate over whether AVGO stock is fairly valued and worth buying.

stories.name: Marvell's AI Growth Debate
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are divided over whether Marvell Technology's stock, which has fallen sharply since June despite strong AI infrastructure growth and margin gains, represents a buying opportunit

stories.name: Broadcom's $230B AI Forecast
stories.blurb: Broadcom projects its AI chip revenue will surge to $230 billion by 2028, fueling debate over its growth trajectory and competitive positioning against Nvidia.

stories.name: Apple-Broadcom Chip Deal
stories.blurb: Apple has committed over $30 billion to a multi-year deal with Broadcom to supply custom chips, including U.S.-made wireless components, extending their partnership through 2031.

stories.name: AI Infrastructure Bubble Debate
stories.blurb: Coverage of the debate over whether massive AI infrastructure spending (chips, data centers, and vendor financing led by Nvidia, Broadcom, and others) is sustainable or a bubble at risk of collapse.

Chip stocks rally broadly on July 6

Semiconductor stocks enter bear market selloff
Analysts raise Broadcom price targets post-Q3

5.text: AMD briefly crossed a $1 trillion market cap for the first time, with shares up about 10% and over 180% this year, making it the fourth U.S. chipmaker to hit that mark. Semiconductor stocks broadly rallied to multi-month highs even as China's influence on chip demand faded.

6.text: Broadcom reported record Q3 FY26 revenue of $29.6B, up 85.5% year-over-year, with AI semiconductor revenue up 221%, and completed a 41-million-share buyback worth about $10.93B. Despite this, the stock has fallen roughly 28% from its $494 high to $357 amid concerns over AI demand, margins, customer concentration, and China risk.

7.text: Marvell raised its revenue outlook but its stock fell 16.4% over three months, even as it gained 203% year-to-date on AI data-center growth. Wall Street remains divided over customer concentration, thin margins, Broadcom competition, and a stretched valuation ahead of an investor day.

8.text: Broadcom reported its ninth straight earnings beat with triple-digit AI revenue growth and guided custom AI chip revenue from $16.7B in Q3 FY2026 to $230B by FY2028. Anthropic is expected to overtake Google as Broadcom's largest custom chip customer, though the stock moved little and fell 2% as the $230B target raised delivery concerns.

10.text: Nvidia and Meta face a reported $300 billion AI problem tied to off-balance-sheet debt, while Nvidia holds a $279 billion supply commitment that could suffer if AI demand fades. Analysts debate Nvidia's valuation and whether it is effectively funding its own rally, and question Arm Holdings' stretched share price.
